{{Top}}
[[File:Trade_Federation_Blast_Door_Episode_I.png|thumb|right|250px|The closed blast doors of a [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class battleship]]]]
{{Quote|Open the blast doors! Open the blast doors!|[[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]]|audio=OpenTheBlastDoors.flac|<ref name="Episode 4">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
A '''blast door''', alternatively referred to as a '''shielded door''' or '''safety door''', was a type of door found on many [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and high-security facilities.

==Description==
{{Quote|Close the blast doors! [...] That will hold them.''"''<br />''"''They're still coming through!''"''<br />''"''This is impossible!|[[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] and [[Rune Haako/Legends|Rune Haako]] reacting to [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]]'s lightsaber penetrating their blast doors|<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
[[File:Death_Star_blast_door.png|thumb|right|180px|Blast doors closing on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]].]]
Blast doors were extra doors that were closed next to a room's regular entrance or other closed door to provide extra reinforcements against hostile forces such as explosives, powerful [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], or even [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]]. Blast doors could also be used to seal off a portion of a ship which has been breached from the vacuum of [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. 

==History==
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] tried to melt through a blast door with his [[Qui-Gon Jinn's lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to get to the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Viceroy]]. His efforts were met with initial success, but the [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]] on the ship drove him away before he could finish. In [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] society, which focused heavily on one's status, this symbolism extended to the blast doors on the [[Saak'ak/Legends|''Saak'ak'']], with three blast doors indicating that the ones behind the room were of very high-level and were thus superior. Blast doors were also present on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star I]] as large rectangular doors that slowly opened and closed. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] escaped from pursuing [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] by leaping through a closing blast door during their [[Rescue of Princess Leia/Legends|rescue]] of [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]].
